profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your workspace identity and connection information

industry.title: Industry
industry.description: Set your organisation's industry once here and it will be applied automatically to all new pipeline runs, AI comment jobs, and other kickoff flows. Per-job industry dropdowns are hidden when this is set.
industry.label: Industry
industry.when_set: All new jobs will use this industry. You can still change it per-run from the run detail page.
industry.when_unset: When not set, each job kickoff will show an industry dropdown for per-run selection.

ai_output.title: AI Output Language
ai_output.description: Choose the language used by Forge when generating AI descriptions for tables and columns. This is independent from the UI language — identifiers (table names, columns, data types) always stay verbatim.
ai_output.comment_language_hint: Used as the default for new AI Comment jobs. You can still override it per-job from the AI Comments page.

data_sampling.title: Data Sampling
data_sampling.description: Control whether sample rows are fetched from tables during use case discovery and SQL generation. Real data values help the AI understand what each table contains, producing more relevant use cases and more accurate SQL queries. Trade-off: reads row-level data and increases run time.
data_sampling.privacy_body_pre: When data sampling is enabled, Forge reads a small number of rows from each table during use case discovery and SQL generation. This data is sent to the AI model alongside the schema so it can understand real data values, formats, and patterns -- producing better use cases and more accurate SQL. Sampled data is

estate_scan.title: Estate Scan
estate_scan.description: Run environment intelligence (domain classification, PII detection, health scoring, lineage enrichment) during pipeline runs. This increases run time but provides a comprehensive estate view alongside use case discovery.

scan.label: Estate Scan during pipeline runs
scan.enabled: Enabled — metadata extraction will include full environment intelligence enrichment
scan.disabled: Disabled — pipeline runs will skip the estate scan enrichment pass (faster runs)

asset_discovery.label: Asset Discovery during pipeline runs
asset_discovery.enabled: Enabled — existing Genie spaces, dashboards, and metric views will be discovered and used to improve recommendations
asset_discovery.disabled: Disabled — recommendations are generated without awareness of existing analytics assets (faster runs)

benchmarks.label: Benchmark Catalog
benchmarks.unavailable: Unavailable — server-side flag FORGE_BENCHMARKS_ENABLED is not set in the deployment configuration
benchmarks.enabled: Enabled — industry benchmarks are embedded and injected into pipeline prompts and Ask Forge retrieval
benchmarks.disabled: Disabled — pipeline uses generic advisory context; benchmark catalog page and API are hidden

semantic_search.title: Semantic Search & RAG
semantic_search.description: Enable semantic search, knowledge base, and AI-grounded retrieval across your data estate. Turning this off hides search and knowledge base features but does not delete existing embeddings.

toggle.label: Semantic Search & RAG
toggle.enabled: Enabled — global search, knowledge base, and AI-grounded retrieval are active
toggle.disabled: Disabled — search bar and knowledge base are hidden; embeddings are preserved for re-activation

rebuild.label: Rebuild Embeddings
rebuild.description: Re-generate the vector knowledge base from all estate scans, pipelines, and documents.

discovery_depth.title: Discovery Depth
discovery_depth.description: Configure the parameters for each discovery depth level and choose the default. Each level controls how many use cases are generated per batch, the minimum quality threshold, and the maximum output volume. You can still override the depth level per-run.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Good mix of breadth and quality

discovery_depth.batch_target_label: Batch target (min-max use cases per batch)
discovery_depth.adaptive_cap_label: Adaptive cap (max use cases in output)

genie.title: Genie Engine
genie.description: Global defaults for Genie Space generation. These apply to all new runs. Per-run configuration (glossary, custom SQL, column overrides, benchmarks, instructions) is still editable within each run.

engine.label: Genie Engine
engine.enabled: Enabled — LLM-powered Genie Space generation is active for all runs
engine.disabled: Disabled — Engine config will be read-only in runs; only legacy generation available

max_auto_spaces.label: Max spaces to auto-analyse
max_auto_spaces.suffix: 0 = all domains (default). Limits auto-generation; you can always regenerate more from the Genie Workbench.

entity_matching.label: Entity Matching
entity_matching.hint: Auto uses sample data to detect value aliases (e.g. "Florida" → "FL")

question_complexity.label: Question Complexity
question_complexity.tip: Controls the language style of sample questions generated for Genie Spaces. Simple: short plain-English questions. Medium: slightly more specific with business concepts. Complex: analytical language with trends, correlations, and technical terms.
question_complexity.hint: Simple produces short, everyday questions. Medium adds business context. Complex uses analytical language.

deploy_auth.label: Deploy Authentication
deploy_auth.tip: Controls which identity is used when creating, updating, or deleting Genie Spaces in Databricks. User (OBO) uses the logged-in user's credentials; Service Principal uses the app's service principal.
deploy_auth.hint_obo: Spaces are created under your identity. You must have access to the referenced tables.
deploy_auth.hint_sp: Spaces are created under the app's service principal. The SP must have SELECT access to the referenced tables.

llm_refinement.label: LLM Refinement
llm_refinement.description: Use AI to generate semantic expressions, instructions, and trusted assets

trusted_assets.label: Trusted Assets
trusted_assets.description: Generate parameterized SQL queries and UDF definitions

auto_benchmarks.label: Auto Benchmarks
auto_benchmarks.description: Generate test questions with expected SQL to evaluate Genie accuracy

metric_views.label: Metric Views
metric_views.description: Propose metric view definitions (KPIs, dimensions, measures)

auto_time_periods.label: Auto Time Periods
auto_time_periods.description: Generate standard date filters and dimensions (last week, last month, fiscal quarters)

export.title: Export & Naming
export.description: Default export format, notebook path, and naming prefix for Unity Catalog resources
export.prefix_tip: Prefix applied to all Unity Catalog resources (views, metric views, tables) created by Forge. Makes it easy to identify Forge-generated objects in your database. Must be lowercase alphanumeric/underscores and end with an underscore.

data_management.title: Data Management
data_management.description: Manage local settings and cached data

clear.label: Clear local settings
clear.description: Reset all preferences to their defaults. This does not affect pipeline runs or use cases stored in Lakebase.

dialog.title: Clear local settings?
dialog.body: This will reset all preferences (data sampling, export format, notebook path) to their defaults. Pipeline runs and data are not affected.

delete.label: Delete all data
delete.description: Permanently delete all pipeline runs, use cases, environment scans, Genie spaces, conversations, exports, and cached data. This cannot be undone.

dialog.title: Delete all application data?
dialog.body: This will permanently delete all pipeline runs, use cases, environment scans, Genie recommendations, dashboards, exports, prompt logs, and cached metadata. Local settings will also be reset. This action cannot be undone.

demo.title: Demo Mode
demo.description: Generate custom synthetic demo datasets for customer engagements. Research a company, design tables, and write directly to Unity Catalog.

page.title: AI Comments
page.subtitle: Generate and apply industry-aware descriptions for tables and columns in Unity Catalog.

empty.title: No comment jobs yet
empty.description: Generate AI-powered descriptions for your tables and columns. Review, edit, and apply them directly to Unity Catalog.
